inputs: paired detector raw_fisheye COCO17 pixels and independent reference pixels, original admitted and reference masks, all rejection reasons, subject/original_action/sequence/frame/physical timestamps and PnP camera roles
forbidden_references: same detector outputs used as labels
fit_scope: train only; artificial known-noise fixture allowed only split=fixture. Validation is frozen evaluation, test is not used to fit or tune. Group disjoint before augmentation.
unique_variable: reference-residual precision preparation, not network width/depth/path/weights
controls: centered covariance vs uncentered second moment under systematic bias
independent vs temporally correlated artificial errors
missing frames remain missing in lag-pair construction
statistics: per-view/joint count, bias, unbiased centered covariance, uncentered second moment E[r r^T]; proxy export uses second moment with explicit numerical eigenfloor0.25px^2 so bias is not silently removed
minimum_count_boundary: engineering sufficiency threshold only; correlated samples are not30 independent observations
temporal: within subject/action/sequence; adjacent original frame IDs and positive physical dt<=0.5s; missing entries never compressed into adjacency; centered within sequence; report pair Pearson correlation and dt range, not NIST uniform-grid ACF or effective sample count
reference_uncertainty: manual-reference residual covariance includes annotation error; unknown reference uncertainty is retained. No silent subtraction or claim of detector-only Gaussian covariance.
noise_export: calibrated=False always at this stage. No promotion from numeric fixtures/record count; independent reference audit, held-out coverage/tails/bias, temporal/cross-view/rig evidence still required. Missing cells block export rather than replacing with10px.
success: reject self-reference/test fit/group leakage; retain nonfinite unknown slots; recover bias-vs-second-moment distinction and known covariance; detect temporal correlation without crossing missing frames/sequence boundaries; keep covariance source separate from calibrated claim
stop: no real calibration on current360 replay or empty training manifest; no label acquisition/download/training; preserve unmet gates
